text:
maya: Quick pulse — Atlas account progression telemetry. QoQ token consumption is down ~12% but WoW is +8% (looks like normalization after the mid-month promo). Noting a latency blip overnight and a small error uptick. Flagging potential renewal risk if latency stays high. Can we triage?

ingest-bot: Automated ingest snapshot:
```
QoQ tokens: -12%
WoW tokens: +8%
24h avg tokens/hr: 4.2k -> 4.6k
P50 latency: 210ms -> 320ms (peak 890ms)
P95 latency: 1.1s
Error rate: 0.62% -> 0.9% (5xx)
Spend change QoQ: +9% (retries + cache-miss)
```

liam: Thanks — adding quick notes. Is this related to the prompt-engine rollout we pushed last week?

sanjay: @maya I traced a spike on the EU cluster around 03:10 UTC. We had kernel OOMs triggering retries. Short logs: 
```
instance: eu-ded-03
service: coalescer
OOM: yes
retries observed: 4-8 per affected request
```
Autoscale engaged but KV cache invalidations caused regen storms.

emma: From CS: Atlas has a billing review next Thurs. If spend continues up we should prepare a mitigation note and a cost breakdown for their execs.

chris: Can we throttle non-prod ingestion for Atlas while infra stabilizes? That should reduce noise and costs quickly.

liam: Proposed immediate plan:
1) Patch kernel on eu-ded-03 within 2h (sanjay)
2) Enforce prefix-level caching to reduce regen (infra + runtime)
3) Temporary rate cap on non-prod API keys (CS + infra)
4) Communicate status to Atlas CSM and finance (emma)
I'll own the rollout coordination. @sanjay take infra ops.

maya: Adding a risk rule: mark as renewal-risk-medium if P50 > 300ms for >48h. Also I'll draft a 1‑pager for Atlas execs summarizing impact + mitigation.

ingest-bot: Patch scheduled by sanjay for 1769238000.

liam: Creating tracking ticket JIRA INF-4729 and will post an updated ingest snapshot after patch. I'll update this thread when numbers stabilize. :thumbsup:
